title: OSDR-PlantMicrobiome: a FAIR relational database, analysis pipeline and interactive report for NASA OSDR plant-associated microbiome datasets
description: A Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable (FAIR) research-software tool that harvests plant-associated microbiome studies from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), integrates their study/assay/factor/sample metadata into a normalised relational (SQLite) database, computes standard microbial-ecology diversity metrics, and renders a single self-contained interactive HTML report with linked dashboards (study registry, sampling design, alpha diversity, Bray-Curtis PCoA ordination, taxonomic composition and a genus-by-tissue niche heatmap). Ships with a curated, versioned registry of confirmed OSDR plant-microbiome accessions (OSD-412/413/414 Veggie leafy greens; OSD-766 tomato; OSD-772 Chile pepper; OSD-773 multi-species) and a live OSDR API fetcher for on-boarding new studies. Fully reproducible (fixed seed); data provenance is tracked per row so repository-sourced facts are distinguishable from tool-derived and illustrative values.
